issue.title: Bug: Incorrect qos parameters on Arista-7060X6-64PE-B-P32O64

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

the qos parameters for this hwsku are not up to date upstream leading to multiple failures in `qos/test_qos_sai.py`. Failures include "PFC counters not triggering", "Egress drop counter not incrementing", "Packet count mismatch", "Watermark values out of expected range".

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `qos/test_qos_sai.py` on Arista-7060X6-64PE-B-P32O64 with lt2-p32o64 topo.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

qos/test_qos_sai.py should pass
